Authoritative CBCG bank register — mine once to build the parent-subsidiary actor map; verification failure is soft.

Static Erste group country page with siblings on domain; context only, no recurring tender signal.

ASEE group-structure page identifies E-Mon Podgorica and other local entities — mine once for the vendor actor map.
MoneyGet .me site is a live Asseco-run ATM network operator revealing local self-service estate and sponsoring banks.
App-store metadata is a strong vendor fingerprint for ME bank digital channels; single-app URL failed, re-check as a publisher-level query.
Halcom solution/reference pages are the supplier-side record of Montenegrin e-banking and certificate deployments.
Local Podgorica integrator for banks/telcos; reference and news pages are rare local-language bank IT contract evidence.
CIKOM discloses consortium wins and contract values, but the LinkedIn channel needs access clearance; prefer its own domain.
Local vendor site plus hosting fingerprint technique; weak recurring signal but in-scope supplier mapping.
ICT Cortex member directory is the best single mine for the domestic supplier actor-map; failed fetch is soft.

Payten/Monri LinkedIn announces acquiring wins early but requires login/ToS clearance before monitoring.
Mastercard newsroom names issuers, acquirers and technology partners in small markets; failed fetch is soft only.
Single Ripple-CBCG release is one-off evidence; the searchable newswire itself, not this URL, is the monitorable source.
ATM/self-service trade press tracking vendor deals and fleet renewals across SEE; useful but not Montenegro-specific.
